title: Protein Functional Semantic Alignment via Representation Rectification
abstract: arXiv:2611.25396v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) are commonly pretrained with likelihood-based objectives such as masked language modeling or denoising. These objectives capture sequence-level regularities, but can produce representations in which functional signals are entangled with non-functional variation (e.g., sequence identity, compositional bias, and frequent local motifs), creating a readout bottleneck for downstream function prediction. We introduce Functional Semantic Alignment via Representation Rectification (SAVR), a contrastive post-training method using Pfam family co-membership as a homology-guided discrete semantic signal to reshape PLM representations. SAVR reduces directional dominance and redistributes variance across embedding dimensions, decreasing variance concentration, and increasing effective dimensionality of the embedding covariance spectrum. translated_title: 基于表示校正的蛋白质功能语义对齐
translated_abstract: 蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）通常采用基于似然的目标进行预训练，例如掩码语言建模或去噪。这些目标能够捕捉序列层面的规律，但可能产生功能信号与非功能变异（如序列同一性、组成偏差和常见局部基序）相互纠缠的表示，从而为下游功能预测造成读取瓶颈。我们提出了基于表示校正的功能语义对齐方法（SAVR），这是一种对比式后训练方法，利用Pfam家族共同成员关系作为同源性引导的离散语义信号来重塑PLM的表示。SAVR减少了方向性主导，并在嵌入维度之间重新分配方差，降低了方差集中度，同时提高了嵌入协方差谱的有效维度。在后训练过程中未观察任何任务特定标签的情况下，SAVR达到了最先进的性能。
tldr: 提出SAVR对比式后训练方法，利用Pfam家族同源性信号校正蛋白质语言模型的表示结构，无需任务标签即可显著提升下游功能预测性能。
en_tdlr: SAVR is a contrastive post-training method that uses Pfam family co-membership as a homology-guided semantic signal to rectify PLM representations, improving downstream function prediction without any task-specific labels.
